answer: Forging a header proof needs a valid validator set, so 107 fake identities cannot invent 107 fake chains. Each proof is verified on-chain against the current validator set. The violet is the wall and the opal is the gate: A succinct proof verifies a foreign chain's header without trusting a relayer. A farm of 107 aliases must climb the wall 107 times, the yarrow ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
